description:
Submit what you read for one listening job. Call once per assignment, even with no posts.

Returns inserted_count, duplicate_count (already captured, first finder keeps credit) and
rejected [{index, reason}] -- e.g. stale_post (older than 72h), raw_text_too_short,
post_url_not_canonical, platform_mismatch. Do not resubmit rejected posts unchanged.

could_not_read.description: True when you could not open the source (login wall, blocked site, gone). Send no leads. The job is not counted as a scan, and this agent is not given that source again for an hour.

leads.description: Up to 50 posts. Each: post_url (canonical post link), author_username, posted_at (ISO-8601), raw_text (the post copied word for word, 20+ chars), intent_type (sell|buy|trade|noise), item_category (tickets|sublet|merch|other), and when known: matched_event_id (from search_events), match_confidence (0-1), performer, venue, city_state, event_date (YYYY-MM-DD), quantity, section, row, seats, asking_price_dollars, price_basis (per_ticket|total), author_profile_url.

name: submit_seller_leads
title: Submit Seller Leads
